abstract: Integrate SolvaPay payments into any project. Covers TypeScript SDK integration for Next.js, React, Express, and MCP Server implementations (including fetch-first MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers and Supabase Edge) with paywall protection, hosted and embedded checkout, account management components (CurrentPlanCard, LaunchCustomerPortalButton, usePaymentMethod), customer portal, usage tracking, and webhooks. Also includes the create-mcp-app skill — create or scaffold a paid MCP app on Cloudflare Workers from either an OpenAPI / Swagger document (auto-generated tools, intent-driven clustering) or hand-written tools, with paywall wiring and inline templates. And provider account onboarding from setup through live launch.
